items: 3 chicken breasts, cooked and cut into small chunks (or canned chicken)

steps.title: Make the gravy
steps.body: Heat **10½ ounces cream of chicken soup** and **1 cup chicken broth** to make a gravy.

steps.title: Add the chicken
steps.body: Add the chicken chunks and simmer for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: To serve, start with **3 cups steamed rice**, then top with the chicken gravy, then cheese, chow mein noodles, and any other garnishes you like (canned pineapple, canned mandarin oranges, green onions, olives, celery, tomato, bell pepper, slivered almonds, coconut, soy sauce).
